2. Unity. Consistency of low-scale, closely-spaced structures with related ornamentation. These two streets flank a conservation zone on Wallace Street of questionable architectural value but having few functional deficiencies, involving bathrooms, condition of roofs, walls, etc.

Although the Randolph and Harrison Street structures may have some such deficiencies, their presence in the midst of new construction might retain for the neighborhood a sense of continuity from the past and a softening agent against the sometimes harsh nature of low-cost urban renewal-style architecture.
